definitions.explanation: A period of three years, or the third year in a sequence.

examples.japanese: {三年|さんねん}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{三年|さんねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It's been three years since I came to Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}→完成：01550_kansei⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{三年|さんねん}⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: This project took three years to complete.

notes:
{三年|さんねん} can mean either 'three years' (duration) or 'third year' (position in a sequence, e.g., school year).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {三年|さんねん}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ (three years ago)
- {三年|さんねん}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧ (three years later)
- {三年|さんねん}{間|かん} (for three years — with ⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧ to emphasize duration)
- {三年|さんねん}⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (the third year — ordinal)
- ⟦{三年生|さんねんせい}→三年生：27560_sannensei⟧ (third-year student)

YEAR COUNTING:
Years use ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧: ⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧, ⟦{二年|にねん}→二年：28862_ninen⟧, {三年|さんねん}, {四年|よねん} (note: {四|よ}, not し).

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{三年|さんねん} is a proverb meaning 'perseverance prevails' (literally 'three years on a stone'). Three years is a culturally significant timeframe in Japan — often the expected period to give something a fair try.
